Foxconn Interconnect Technology.why: Makes connectors and cables for AI servers (new-platform rack connectors and cables, copper-based components); H1 2026 cloud end-market revenue up 55.8% on AI-driven server demand
Foxconn Interconnect Technology.evidence: 2026 interim results (08-10-2026): cloud end-market revenue rose 55.8% on AI-driven server demand and rising demand for new platform cabinet connectors and cables, lifting shipments of copper-based component products

players.product: AI-server rack (cabinet) connectors and cables, copper-based interconnect components and high-speed connectors and cable modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue US$2,496 million, up 8.3% YoY; profit US$38 million, up 26.3%; gross margin 19.13% vs 18.59%, on product mix and favourable exchange rates. By end market: smartphones up 2.9%, cloud up 55.8%, consumer interconnects down 20.6%, auto mobility down 6.2%, system products up 14.9%.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue US$2,496 million (+8.3%); profit US$38 million (+26.3%); gross margin 19.13%

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloud end-market revenue US$551.51 million in H1 2026 (22.1% of revenue), up 55.8% YoY: AI-driven server demand and rising demand for new-platform cabinet connectors and cables increased shipments of copper-based component products, and the new-platform shipments also lifted the company's general-purpose server products.
quarterly_data.figure: Cloud revenue US$551.51 million (+55.8%, 22.1% of revenue)

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: management expects the cloud end market to remain a key growth driver as AI-server and satellite-communication demand grows; the company has prioritized high-speed connectors and cable modules, continues to deploy core component technologies for optical communications and is deepening cooperation opportunities with leading chip manufacturers to cover the optical interconnection field.

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Consumer interconnects revenue fell 20.6% in H1 2026 because of shortages of upstream components such as memory chips; management says tight memory supply may affect end-device output and lead to price hikes that dampen consumer demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 capex US$181 million (H1 2025: US$275 million), mainly for new production complexes in response to customers' globalization expectations and for upgrading production and R&D facilities; capital commitments US$91 million at June 30, 2026; inventory turnover rose to 97 days on inventory built for new production complexes.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex US$181 million; capital commitments US$91 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: two customers each contributed over 10% of H1 2026 revenue: Customer A (a brand company and its nominated contract manufacturers) US$771.67 million and Customer B (a group of related companies) US$285.70 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A US$771.67 million; Customer B US$285.70 million
